description: This file defines the ActivityDetailsReportController class within the OrangeHRM Time plugin. It extends an abstract Vue controller and manages the preparation of data for rendering an activity details report, including handling query parameters for date range, project, activity, and timesheet inclusion.

classes.name: ActivityDetailsReportController
classes.description: Controller responsible for preparing activity details report data, handling query parameters, and configuring the Vue component for the report.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares and sets up the Vue component with properties based on the request's query parameters for rendering the activity details report.
